Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files with different encryption depending on file type: fully encrypts .txt and .md files appending .fully.cryptoNar extension; partially encrypts first 1,024 bytes of other files appending .partially.cryptoNar extension
Sends public/private key pair to attacker via email (SMTP)
Drops ransom note demanding $200 in bitcoins with instructions to provide email and ID in bitcoin transaction extra note
Launches decryptor waiting for private key input after ransom payment
Impacted Systems: Victims' file systems with encrypted files including .txt, .md, .jpg, .png, .pdf, .doc, .xls
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file named CRYPTONAR RECOVERY INFORMATION.txt
Bitcoin ransom demand of $200 with victim email and ID in transaction extra note
